policies.name: Default-Deny Unknown Egress Hosts
policies.description: Blocks any agent HTTP or MCP tool call targeting an external host outside your organization's verified domain allowlist.
policies.cedar_expr: forbid (principal, action, resource) unless { resource.host in context.org_allowed_hosts };

policies.name: Protect Safety Monitoring & Alerting Configs
policies.description: Prevents autonomous coding or ops agents from disabling or modifying security monitoring and alerting pipelines.
policies.cedar_expr: forbid (principal is Agent, action in [Action::"write", Action::"delete"], resource) when { resource.path like "/monitoring/*" || resource.path like "/alerts/*" };

policies.name: Forbid Autonomous Destructive Deletes
policies.description: Hard guardrail preventing any AI agent or sub-agent from executing destructive delete or drop_table operations without human intervention.
policies.cedar_expr: forbid (principal is Agent, action in [Action::"delete", Action::"drop_table"], resource);

policies.name: Block Unissued / Stolen Static Credentials
policies.description: Rejects any outbound request carrying an API key or bearer token that was not dynamically minted for the active attested run.
policies.cedar_expr: forbid (principal is Agent, action, resource) when { !context.credential_issued_to_run || !context.dpop_verified };

policies.name: Require OpenID CIBA Step-Up for High-Risk Actions
policies.description: Holds any high-sensitivity mutation or money-movement call (score 0.30–0.75) and dispatches a live approval request to the dashboard.
policies.cedar_expr: permit (principal is Agent, action == Action::"payment_transfer", resource) when { context.ciba_human_approved == true };
